description: Removes an auto-ordering configuration by autoOrderingAccountRef returned by hgr_get_autoordering_configuration for one visible store/channel. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally, confirmed=true and impactConfirmed=true after warning about consequences.

autoOrderingAccountRef.description: Opaque auto-ordering account reference returned by hgr_get_autoordering_configuration.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.

impactConfirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly confirmed the concrete high-impact consequences.

name: hgr_remove_autoordering_configuration
title: Remove Autoordering Configuration
